ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric fields occupy the distal portions of both lobes. Dense, irregular black mottling and focal spots are concentrated in the proximal central region near the peduncle and along the trailing edge margins. A distinct circular dark-outlined spot is located on the mid-left lobe, and a prominent vertical dark band is present on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 60 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:4 relative to the inner lobe curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-amplitude serrations are visible along the distal boundaries of the trailing edge. The frequency of peaks increases towards the tips, while the area near the median notch exhibits lower-amplitude, smoother variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trajectory follows a convex sweep from the median notch, transitioning to a linear-concave curve towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of a single prominent circular high-contrast rosette (dark perimeter with light center) on the mid-left lobe. Smaller white-on-black punctate clusters are visible at the inferior-left margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, high-contrast vertical linear disruption (rake mark) extends approximately 1/4 the vertical length of the right lobe. Several smaller, horizontal linear disruptions are visible on the interior of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical linear trauma on the right lobe; prominent circular rosette scar on the left lobe; irregular serrated erosion on the terminal distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy water spray/mist (high-intensity white noise) occludes the lower peduncle junction and portions of the interior trailing edge boundary.
